response.original_title: England Expects: With Nelson to Victory
response.overview: A ground-breaking documentary from BNPtv - superbly filmed and edited by Roderick Gordon, scripted and researched by Eddy Butler, featuring Nick Griffin, Eddy Butler and Jonathan Bowden, with an original music score, and filmed on location in Norfolk, Kent, Hampshire and London.  Made in 2005 to commemorate the 200th anniversary of the Battle of Trafalgar, this outstanding piece of documentary journalism surpasses anything from the mainstream media on this subject. It tells the story of one of England's first and greatest celebrity heroes,  Admiral Lord Nelson up to his tragic death at the Battle of Trafalgar.
